items.title: Nasdaq (NDAQ) Stock May Trade At A Premium As Board Changes Loom
items.summary: Nasdaq, Inc. has delivered strong share price gains over the past few years, which puts a bright spotlight on whether the current valuation is supported by the returns it earns on its capital. With the stock now in a very different place to where it was three years ago, the key issue for you is how much of those returns are already reflected in today’s price.
